DeductGold.Name: Deduct Gold on Transcription
DeductGold.Hint: When enabled, transcribing a spell deducts 50 gp per spell level from the wizard's total currency (PP, GP, EP, SP, CP).

RequireGold.Name: Require Sufficient Gold
RequireGold.Hint: When enabled, wizards cannot transcribe a spell unless their total coin wealth covers the ink cost.
